title: Deslop
line: Flag formulaic wording when the agent edits prose.

beats.caption: The first draft adds a filler phrase.
Deslop flags the wording on the write result.

aside.title: What the model sees

takeaway.title: Keep the claim

notes: TypeSafe is switched off in this fixture so the scene demonstrates the built-in pattern check.

title.text: A short piece of documentation can get padded with phrases that add very little.

scene.text: The agent writes the description. Deslop’s local check flags a filler phrase in the write result. The agent keeps what the sentence says and drops the words that delayed it.

takeaway.text: Keep the wording that helps the reader. When a phrase adds nothing to the claim, the shorter sentence is easier to use.
